## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: the fan-design read

**Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², B 0→10 T):** clean two-tone record. FFT (B ∈ [1, 10] T, δF = 1.11 T): **7.8 T + 28.9 T**, sum 36.7 T = **1.108 × F_L** — a single global density scale inside the lever-arm prior (0.8–1.2), partition **0.21 / 0.79** vs ABAB model 0.22 / 0.78 at this n (`fs_count_b0`: 7.31 / 25.78 T). Higher peaks at 44.4 T (= sum + light, intermod) and ~58.9 T (≈ 2×heavy) — combination content, not new pockets. Light tone censored at the record's low edge (oscillations persist below 1 T; the 50 mT leg undersamples it below ~0.84 T, so the true onset is unpinned but < 1 T). **Caveat that motivates the fan:** the tracker's light fundamental is 7.11 T and 4 × 7.11 = 28.4 sits within δF of the heavy tone — heavy-as-4th-harmonic is not excluded on a single density; the model ratio sweeps 6.6 → 3.5 across n = 1.5 → 3.2×10¹², so the fan's n-trajectory screen separates them immediately.

**Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², B 10→0.3 T):** the predicted near-CNP exception regime — close, balanced low tones (tracker fundamentals ≈ 4.7 / 8.5 / 12.3 T against a model pair 5.3 / 7.1 T; the 12.3 T tone sits at F_L, but on a beat-like short record none of this is stable across extraction choices). Preview only; hole side is also gate-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² (never reaches the separated-template regime), so it cannot carry the call.

**Read:** electron side is the fan side. Two resolved tones tracking the ABAB template at one density — **consistent-with, not a call**; the classification needs F(n) across density (partition robustness + harmonic screen + F_L-tone origin), which is the Landau fan's job. Advances the arc: investigation Step 3 done, Step 4 (fan) is next.

"""Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), electron n=+3.2e12 / hole n=-1.2e12, D=0."""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_fft, sdh_onset, luttinger_frequency

RUNS = {6: +3.2e12, 7: -1.2e12}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
reads = {}
for i, (rid, n_cm2) in enumerate(RUNS.items()):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    assert not r.interrupted
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / (-1e6)          # transimpedance -1e6 V/A (device card)
    R = r.col("sr1_X") / I               # sr1 unity gain
    o = np.argsort(B); Bs, Rs = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n_cm2) * 1e4))

    # raw first
    ax = axes[0, i]
    ax.plot(Bs, Rs, lw=0.6)
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)",
           title=f"run {rid} raw — n = {n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (T = {np.median(r.col('T_sample')):.2f} K)")

    # per-tone onset (statistical, matched-filter; clip check vs 50 uV FS)
    onset = sdh_onset(Rs, Bs, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I)))
    fund = [(t.freq, t.censored) for t in onset.tones if t.harmonic_of is None and not t.near_residual]

    # FFT over the well-sampled 10 mT/20 mT leg
    b_lo = 1.0 if rid == 6 else 0.75
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(Rs.reshape(-1, 1), Bs, b_range=(b_lo, 10.0), nfft=4096)
    sp = spec[0]
    pk, _ = find_peaks(sp, height=np.median(sp) + 2 * sp.std(), distance=8)
    peaks = sorted(zip(freqs[pk], sp[pk]), key=lambda t: -t[1])[:6]
    ax2 = axes[1, i]
    ax2.plot(freqs, sp, lw=0.8)
    ax2.axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    ax2.set(xlim=(0, 2 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="|FFT|",
            title=f"run {rid} FFT, B in [{b_lo}, 10] T (dF = {1/(1/b_lo-0.1):.2f} T)")
    ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
    reads[rid] = (FL, peaks, onset.onset_b, fund)
    print(f"run {rid}: F_L = {FL:.2f} T | onset_b = {onset.onset_b:.2f} T | "
          f"fundamentals (tracker): {[(round(f,2), 'censored' if c else 'tracked') for f, c in fund]}")
    for f, a in peaks:
        print(f"   FFT peak {f:6.2f} T  amp {a:7.1f}   f/F_L = {f/FL:.3f}")
fig.tight_layout()

# --- the read against the fs_count_b0 model (n in m^-2) ---
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs
FL6 = reads[6][0]
f_light, f_heavy = 7.78, 28.88            # run 6 FFT peaks
s_sum = (f_light + f_heavy) / FL6
_, orb = abab_fs(3.2e16)
m_light, m_heavy = orb[0][0], orb[1][0]
print(f"\nrun 6 (electron): pair sum {f_light + f_heavy:.1f} T = {s_sum:.3f} x F_L "
      f"(lever-arm band 0.8-1.2 -> global scale {s_sum:.3f})")
print(f"  partition {f_light/(f_light+f_heavy):.3f}/{f_heavy/(f_light+f_heavy):.3f} "
      f"vs ABAB model {m_light/(m_light+m_heavy):.3f}/{m_heavy/(m_light+m_heavy):.3f} (model {m_light:.2f}/{m_heavy:.2f} T)")
print(f"  ABAB-template pair; NOT yet a call: heavy = 4 x 7.11 T (tracker fundamental) is within dF -> "
      f"harmonic vs real pocket is n-dependence work (the fan). No tone at F_L x scale = {s_sum*FL6:.1f} T beyond the pair sum's intermods.")
print("run 7 (hole): near-CNP exception regime as designed — close balanced tones "
      f"(tracker fundamentals {[round(f,2) for f,_ in reads[7][3]]} T vs model pair 5.3/7.1 T), short 1/B record; preview only, not evidence.")
print("VERDICT: electron side is the fan side (two resolved tones, censored onset < 1 T, clean record).")

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:29** · LF electron D=0: n 1.00-3.24e12 (101 pts, paired n-line), B 0.7-10 T uniform-1/B (161 rows, d(1/B)=0.0083), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau); ends at 10 T, gates park 0 · **ETA ~16:29** (≈11h)

Investigation step 4 (`tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`), following the spot-check read (ana, runs 6–7): electron side carries two tones 7.8 + 28.9 T at n = +3.2×10¹², summing to 1.108×F_L with an ABAB-like 0.21/0.79 partition — but one density cannot separate heavy-pocket from 4th-harmonic (4×7.11 T falls within δF of 28.9 T), nor pass the F_L-tone origin screen. The fan reads F(n) of every tone across density: partition robustness f₁+f₂ = F_L(n), the harmonic screen (a harmonic tracks 4f exactly; the model ABAB ratio sweeps 6.6→3.5 over this window), and the dual ABAB/trilayer overlay.

**Design (computed, `hera_scratch/fan_design.py`):**
- **Fast axis**: paired n-line at D = 0, n = 3.24 → 1.00 ×10¹² cm⁻², 101 pts (run-5 cal). n_max = 3.24 puts Vtg at +0.995 V, 5 mV under the validator. δn = 2.24×10¹⁰ → 3.0 rows per LL ray at 0.7 T (≥2 floor, prefer-3 met). Claim window is n ≳ 2×10¹² (templates separated); the 1.0–2.0 columns map the low-n exception regime and anchor the F(n) trajectory, hedged accordingly.
- **Slow axis**: B = 0.7 → 10 T **uniform in 1/B**, 161 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.0083 T⁻¹ — 3 samples/period on F_L(n_max) even at lever-arm scale 1.2 (40.2 T), FFT fold at 60 T clears the 2×heavy harmonic (≈58 T) unaliased. δF = 1/(1/0.7 − 0.1) = **0.75 T**: heavy-vs-F_L split at n_max is 7.7 T ≈ 10δF; ABAB partner at n = 2.0×10¹² (model 3.9 T) gets 5.2 periods — the investigation's ≥5 floor. B_lo = 0.7 T is below the censored run-6 onset bound (<1 T) and prices the light tone's low-B reach; heavy-tone (m* ≈ 0.06) rows below ~1.5 T are LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K — expected, not a defect.
- **Sensitivity**: sr1 fixed 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS at 10 nA for the whole fan. Worst corner (low-n × 10 T): run-7 anchor 587 Ω at |n| = 1.2×10¹², 10 T → ~12% FS there; ≥4× headroom against SdH maxima. Saturation is the unrecoverable failure; resolution is sacrificed knowingly.
- **Dwell**: fast_delay = 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct) — the per-column-FFT case of the base recipe's step 7; slow_delay = 1 s.
- **Coverage trade**: hole side excluded — gate-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² (never reaches the separated-template regime, run 7 confirms the beat tangle); full coverage would cost a second ~10 h fan for uninformative columns.

**Price**: grid 161×101 = 16,261 pts × 1.97 s/pt (run-5 calibration: 0.17 s reads + fast_delay) ≈ 8.9 h; traverse 0→10 T ≈ 73 min (0.137 T/min); row settles + turnaround ≈ 25 min → **10.4 h**, headline **11 h** with the session's 5–10% overrun bias. Starts at 0 T (magnet is there), **ends at 10 T** with gates parked at 0 — the follow-up (LK mass cuts or a measured ride-down) starts from 10 T, no re-traverse.

**Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed, `data --next --follow`): first 2–3 rows — leakage, rail (>60% FS), dead channel, field-readback tracking; then ~every 2–3 h on landed-row digests; interim per-column FFT once rows pass B ≈ 2 T (~70% through the row count, where the 1/B record starts resolving tones). Abort criteria: leak trip (in-cell guard at 1 nA), rail, or T_sample off base > 1.5 K.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n 3.24 -> 1.00 e12 (fast) x B 0.7 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (slow) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(3.24, 1.00, 101)               # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 2.24e10
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)                          # D = 0 (investigation operating point)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"fast axis: n = {ns[0]:.2f} -> {ns[-1]:.2f} e12 ({len(ns)} pts); "
      f"Vtg [{Vtgs.min():+.4f}, {Vtgs.max():+.4f}], Vbg [{Vbgs.min():+.4f}, {Vbgs.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B for the per-column FFT ---
B_vec = field_invB(0.7, 10.0, 161)              # d(1/B) = 0.0083 /T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"slow axis: B = {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows, d(1/B) = {(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1])/(len(B_vec)-1):.5f} /T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts with the 0.7 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (worst corner: n = 1.0e12 x 10 T; run-7 anchor 587 Ohm at |n|=1.2e12, 10 T) ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)                          # 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA
I_TRIP = 1e-9
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0               # 6*tau (tau = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct) — per-column-FFT dwell, base recipe step 7
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> ~10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, "
      f"slope {sr1.filter_slope()}; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan electron side: n = +1.00..+3.24e12 (101), D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  "B 0.7 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (161), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0.00 V/nm: n = {ns[-1]:.2f} to {ns[0]:.2f} e12 cm^-2 (101 pts, fast, paired n-line); '
              f'B = 0.7 to 10 T uniform-1/B (161 rows, d(1/B) = 0.0083); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'follows spot checks runs 6-7 (tones 7.8 + 28.9 T at n = +3.2e12)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    # field stays at 10 T deliberately: the follow-up (LK cuts / ride-down) starts there — never re-traverse.
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked at 0, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
